content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Baton Rouge

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of experience. Review PMI's full criteria to confirm you meet the education and hands-on project leadership requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions online at your own pace, gain practical frameworks aligned to the PMBOK® Guide, and receive course materials and resources designed to accelerate your readiness.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, apply directly to PMI through their online portal. Report your verified project-management experience, confirm your education credentials, and pay the PMI examination fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the submission process and answer procedural questions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and one-on-one support, to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE and sit for the computer-based PMP® exam at an authorized test center near Baton Rouge.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® is valid for three years. During your certification cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or on-the-job project leadership. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you meet PMI's renewal requirements and stay current.
